salon.description: Living room of a 4-room council flat on the 7th floor of a French HLM tower, evening. Large grey fabric sofa with cushions, big flat-screen TV showing a football match, low coffee table with two remotes, plastic water bottles and a tea glass, large patterned rug, glass display cabinet with decorative plates and a tea set, thick burgundy curtains half open, balcony door showing lit windows of the neighbouring concrete towers at dusk. Lived-in details: phone charger, folded blanket, slippers.
salon.lumiere: Warm, homely evening light: warm ceiling lamp and floor lamp, cool blue TV glow on faces, blue dusk through the balcony window.

cuisine.description: Kitchen of the same flat: big family table with oilcloth, fridge covered with magnets and school papers, open cupboards full of food, pots simmering on the stove, spice jars, worktop with chopped vegetables, dishes drying, a wooden spoon.
cuisine.lumiere: Warm tungsten kitchen light with steam catching the light.

cite.description: Contemporary French housing estate: several 10 to 15 storey concrete towers in grey and beige, balconies with laundry drying, glazed building entrances with intercoms and letterboxes, benches in front of the towers, a fenced five-a-side pitch where teenagers play football, a corner grocery shop and a kebab shop with lit signs, scooters parked by the entrances, a car park with ordinary French hatchbacks and a few German sedans (no logos), kids playing ball, neighbours chatting at the foot of the towers.
cite.lumiere: Natural urban light, sometimes cold: overcast daylight or sodium street lights at night.
